rows: Two synthetic GPS tracks demonstrating a between-fix crossing and a stop

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Four fixes in EPSG:32618 at UTC times. The crossing entity moves from 10 m west to 10 m east of a 20 m wide fence in 120 seconds; neither fix is inside. The stopped entity remains inside for 600 seconds. Use with the bundled fences.json.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Demo GPS fixes

Four fixes in EPSG:32618 at UTC times. The crossing entity moves from 10 m west to 10 m east of a 20 m wide fence in 120 seconds; neither fix is inside. The stopped entity remains inside for 600 seconds. Use with the bundled fences.json.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Count observations per synthetic entity", "sql": "SELECT entity_id, count(*) FROM trajectory.main.demo_input GROUP BY entity_id ORDER BY entity_id"}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "Demo GPS fixes on bundled synthetic data", "sql": "SELECT entity_id, count(*) FROM trajectory.main.demo_input GROUP BY entity_id ORDER BY entity_id", "expected_result": [["crossing", 2], ["stopped", 2]]}]
